## Grounding

Real market-standard discipline: royalty accounting and splits
reporting for independent labels (calculation transparency, split
agreements, quarterly reporting). **Worked example** cited by
reference, never re-derived: legacy formation `LOS-01` ("Label
Operations Manager," `backend/seed_data.py:793-805`, 42h, badge
"Label Operations Manager"), specifically module `LOS-01-M06`
("Royalties, splits et reporting artistes," `backend/
seed_modules.py`) — deliverable "Rapport royalties trimestriel
modèle" (a quarterly royalty report template). Per the corpus's own
code-collision discipline, this row's internal document code is
`LOS-EXT-03`, never bare `LOS-03`, to prevent any confusion with the
legacy runtime `LOS-01` formation's own module numbering.

## Prerequisites

`LOS-EXT-01` (foundation cross-reference).

## Objectives

1. Build a quarterly royalty report at professional specialization
   depth, citing `LOS-01-M06`'s real deliverable template as the
   worked example (survey depth), never re-deriving it from scratch —
   this formation deepens the report's transparency/audit-trail
   dimension beyond the legacy survey.
2. Explain split-agreement mechanics (how a royalty pool divides among
   collaborators) at a professional-specialization depth, distinct
   from `LOS-01`'s generalist "Label Operations Manager" survey
   coverage of the same theme.
3. Never conflate this row's document code (`LOS-EXT-03`) with the
   legacy runtime formation code `LOS-01`, and never re-teach
   `LOS-01`'s 8 real modules as if they were new content here (cited
   by reference only, per `LOS-EXT-01`).
